blocks.html: The exhaust system may be connected to a chimney used for other appliances, provided that the chimney complies with Section 811.1, Item 1 or Section 811.1, Item 2 and the operation of the engine does not adversely affect the operation of the other appliances and is in accordance with the New York City Air Pollution Control Code.
